language-modes.note: site/app.js provides the same English, Cantonese, and bilingual control on every top-level and composed article page. Shared shell labels and statuses switch live, while authored article prose deliberately remains source text and the shell says so. Full article translation remains incomplete.

funny-levels.note: site/app.js exposes independent persisted English and Cantonese controls from 1 to 5 on every page, both defaulting to 5, and routes shared COPY entries through the selected voice level. The complete authored page copy is not yet represented at every level, so this remains partial.

dialog-emojis.note: No show-emojis-in-dialogs toggle or emoji-decoration logic was found in site/app.js.

school-mode.note: No School mode setting, rename, or shared unlock credential was found anywhere in site/app.js or the settings page.

narration.note: No TTS narrator, voice picker, or spoken-event queue was found in site/app.js.

scheduled-settings.note: site/app.js implements a persisted local schedule with start and end times, explicit weekdays, cross-midnight and equal-time semantics, timezone status, and real scheduled theme, language, and density overrides. Base values return when the window ends; the schedule makes no network request.

external-settings-sources.note: No HTTPS API or Home Assistant integration exists; same gap as scheduled-settings.

dim-sum-surprise.note: No startup dim-sum surprise or bundled dish assets were found.

regex-builder.note: site/app.js implements an anchored JavaScript regular-expression builder with literal helpers, i/m/u flags, bounded pattern input, live sample matches, and synchronized apply behavior. It is wired to settings, documentation, command palette, notifications, every upgraded dropdown search, and the page context-menu search.

non-blocking-notifications.note: site/app.js injects the same corner notifications and persisted history on every top-level and composed article page, with search, its anchored regex builder, bulk selection, real bulk dismissal, and selected-row export. Filtered-empty and truly empty histories have distinct messages.

status-hub.note: site/build.mjs embeds a validated build-manifest status record into every composed page and site/status.html renders only that record, including honest unavailable, invalid, and stale release states. A live shared session hub and question delivery channel are not implemented on this public surface.

material-appearance.note: site/app.js implements a genuine infinite-colour-picker/translator (rgbToHsl/hsvToRgb/rgbToLab/rgbToOklab/hwbToRgb/cmykToRgb and translateColour, wired via initColourTranslator) plus theme/density/accent/font-scale controls in initSettings() with a live preview (initSettingsPreview). This covers colour translation and basic tokens well, but there is no per-element "Edit appearance..." editor, no Word-depth typography controls, and no named-preset export/import beyond the general settings export.

app-logo-customization.note: site/app.js exposes three local presets, contain/fill choice, PNG/JPEG upload, byte-signature validation, byte and decoded-pixel bounds, cache revalidation, live application, and clear/reset on every page. Crop, focal-point, background editing, and multi-size output generation remain incomplete.

local-file-converter.note: The site's many to*() functions (toJson, toXml, toYaml, toSql, toToml, toDelimited, toMarkdown, toHtml) convert the documentation/notification export data into different text formats - this is export formatting (complete-exports), not a general-purpose local file converter with a category catalogue and bundled adapters. No such converter surface exists.

ollama-suite-manager.note: No Ollama integration of any kind exists in the site.

browser-style-tabs.note: Every top-level and composed article page now receives the same ARIA tablist navigation with persisted left, right, top, and bottom docking and responsive collapse to the compact header. Reordering, pinning, grouping, and the four independent tab searches remain incomplete.

tab-groups-and-searches.note: No tabs exist on the site at all (see browser-style-tabs), so there are no tab groups or tab searches.

command-palette.note: site/app.js injects the command palette on every page, opens it from the visible control or Ctrl+Shift+F, searches pages, direct composed article URLs, and exact shared controls, and opens the selected control with focus. Destination results no longer target paginated cards that may be absent.

destructive-action-confirmation.note: site/app.js planBulk() and bulk actions carry a destructive flag (line 299, 309) that changes copy to state "This cannot be undone," and settings-reset is styled as a danger-button, but no two-key-plus-slider super-confirmation gate (the documented contract's specific mechanism) was found - only a plain destructive-labelled action.

local-version-history.note: The documentation catalogue lists a "History" article (app/history, describing append-only local configuration revisions) as PRODUCT documentation content, but no actual history/versions panel, diff view, or restore action exists in the site itself - this is a described feature of the console product, not an implemented feature of the site.

changelog-viewer.note: No changelog viewer, date filter, or commit-link rendering was found in site/app.js.

external-editor-handoff.note: No open-in-external-editor / VS Code handoff exists on the site.

complete-exports.note: site/app.js implements JSON, JSONL, YAML, TOML, XML, CSV, TSV, Markdown, HTML, and SQL export for suitable tabular records. The shared site-state export includes every persisted setting and notification and explicitly names the omitted personal-vocabulary payload, source metadata, and custom-logo bytes instead of silently dropping them.

bulk-actions.note: site/app.js implements planBulk()/summariseBulk()/bulkClick()/bulkSelectAll() with a reviewable affected/skipped preview and a destructive flag, wired into notification bulk-select/dismiss (initNotificationBulk).

accessibility.note: site/app.js implements a real WCAG contrast calculator (contrastRatio/contrastVerdict) used by the colour translator, and sr-only labels appear in settings.html, but no site-wide audit of focus order, ARIA roles, or reduced-motion coverage beyond the one reduceMotion() check in the counter animation (line 967) was verified.

responsive-sizing.note: site/styles.css keeps the body at a 320px minimum, collapses side-docked navigation to a compact header below 900px, reduces all shared settings and record grids to one column, bounds and scrolls overlays, wraps long digests, and preserves touch-sized controls.

personal-vocabulary-upload.note: site/app.js keeps a visible upload and clear path on every page, validates schema version, fields, entry count, unsafe and duplicate keys, and string bounds before caching, then revalidates the complete cache on every read. Reload status is derived from the validated cache and never claims a source file remains loaded.

per-element-toy-locks.note: No per-element lock/unlock mechanism was found anywhere in site/app.js.

support-tickets.note: No Support Tickets surface exists on the site.

unlock-ladder.note: No unlock ladder (dim sum / sums / whack-a-mole / clock) exists; there is nothing to unlock in the first place (see per-element-toy-locks).

built-in-authenticator.note: No TOTP/authenticator surface, QR generation, or code display exists in site/app.js.

attention-modes.note: site/app.js exposes persisted focus, low-stimulation, time-awareness, one-thing-at-a-time, and momentum controls in the shared shell on every page, all off by default. Current focus and elapsed time appear where work is read, and momentum uses a bounded local idle interval.

browser-extension-download-surfaces.note: This is a static documentation/marketing site; there is no browser extension and no Start-download/Downloading/complete dialog surfaces.

offline-documentation-browser.note: site/documentation.html plus renderDestinations()/initDocumentationExport() in site/app.js present a searchable documentation catalogue with per-article export, but this is a static site consuming its own bundled catalogue over the network at page load, not an offline-bundled in-app documentation browser matching the console-app contract.

app-display-name.note: No renameable display-name setting was found on the site.

guided-forms.note: Every site-owned enumerated setting uses a populated picker, and site/app.js upgrades each picker with a local searchable choice surface and adjacent regex builder. The site has no product endpoint wizard because it is not the installed runtime.

bounded-overlays.note: Every injected dialog paints its own bounded scrolling Material surface. The regex builder and context menu use non-modal dialogs positioned beside their trigger point and clamp to the viewport; closing returns control to the originating flow.

context-menu-shortcuts.note: site/app.js provides a real page context menu on every page with local search, an adjacent regex builder, and working site-controls, notification-history, and export actions. The actions currently have no registered keyboard shortcuts to display.

long-operation-progress.note: The only progress-shaped code found is a decorative counter-animation easing function (line 967), not a real operation-progress report inside a start dialog.

in-context-recovery.note: No surface-level recovery route (for example re-authentication offered directly beside a refused action) was found.

provider-markup-rendering.note: No renderer for remote/provider-authored Markdown or rich text was found; documentation content in renderDestinations() is inserted as plain escaped text/HTML built by the site itself, not rendered from provider-authored markup.

forge-publishing.note: No GitHub/forge publishing flow exists; this is a documentation/marketing site with no repository-publishing feature.

collapsible-filters.note: site/settings.html and site/documentation.html use real <details class="collapsible-panel"> elements wrapping the search/filter controls (settings-filters-panel, documentation-filters-panel), wired to updateFilterStatus() in site/app.js which reports match counts into an aria-live status span - a genuine collapsible, accessible filter row.

automatic-updates.note: This is a static site with nothing to auto-update client-side; no update-check/ready-banner logic exists in site/app.js. (The console app's automatic-updates feature is a separate surface tracked on the windows-console row.)
